audit.description: Changed production code in eparse/cli.py replaces the direct click import with import plac and uses the real target API via plac.call(_plac_entry) in entry_point. Static and dynamic evidence show no click imports or source namespace access from changed production code, while plac is imported from site-packages/plac.py during production execution. The only observed click import is from test/dependency context, and the evidence reports no local plac provider or target shim.
evidence: diff eparse/cli.py: removes import click and adds import plac
diff eparse/cli.py: entry_point now returns sys.exit(plac.call(_plac_entry))
static anti-cheat: eparse/cli.py imports_target=true, imports_source=false, dynamic_imports_source=false, fake_target_added_code=false
dynamic anti-cheat: first_target_events_from_repo shows eparse/cli.py line 13 importing plac from after_venv_overlay/.../site-packages/plac.py
reasons: eparse/cli.py meaningfully imports and calls plac
changed production code has no direct or dynamic click use
dynamic target event comes from the installed plac package
no local target provider or shim was detected
